provenance.author: Noam D. Elkies
provenance.paper: An elliptic K3 surface X/Q(t) with Mordell-Weil rank 17, I: Formulas for X and base changes of ranks 18 and 19
provenance.generic_rank_status: exactly 17: the 17 published sections have exact height-pairing determinant 948, and Elkies states rank 17 is maximal over Q(t) for an elliptic K3 surface
provenance.specialization_policy: Every S1..S17 point is evaluated exactly on the specialized curve. Family/Target search may store exact ratpoints hits, but Rank Hunter raises the rigorous specialization lower bound only through its ordinary exact independence-certificate path.
provenance.release_scope: Published MW17 only. Direct subgroup-aware Family/Target point search is included; quadratic rank-jump covers/reconstruction tooling remains intentionally excluded from this RELEASE package, and Elkies Rank-18 First Cover is published separately.
provenance.relationship_to_rank17_release: This is the same published elliptic K3 fibration as the Elkies Rank-17 K3 release, packaged here with X1092/MW-basis provenance and the vectorized family-specific Nagao scorer; it is not a second independent rank-17 theorem.
provenance.icarm_724_relationship: The published X1092 fibration is not asserted to be fiberwise identical to the ICARM #724 generalized fibration; exact rational fibration transport would be required before reusing sections or specialization evidence.
